info.title: NYALES WEB-065 village distribution local API
info.description: Membership alone never transfers customers or expands customer read scope. Assignments use current active confirmed geography cohort, optionally an explicit subset and separately reasoned exception customers. Both channels must be reviewed for customer area transfers; null recipient explicitly unassigns that channel. All relevant org inputs are epoch guarded. Single batch: 50 villages across at most 16 immutable R2 chunks, 25 assignment customers, 600 total prepared statements; larger cohorts require explicit subsets, never silent partial commit. No cloud capacity guarantee. Historical context is current-month observed stored validated current IDR invoice net (whole IDR rupiah), all channels for the full active confirmed selected geography cohort, excluding explicit exceptions; never reattributes invoices/targets/visits/incentives. Preview epoch may be invalidated conservatively by any relevant organization change. Future committed cohort is frozen; later mapping changes do not automatically cancel or expand it.
